methodology.comparison: Parent reader + verified current legacy Manager endpoints vs current reader + navigation endpoint; NOT two complete builds A/B.
methodology.order: Sequential pairs; alternating first mode; each mode uses a fresh reader followed by immediate cached reentry.
methodology.timing: performance.now; fresh reader cache, warm OS/Git filesystem caches; setup, transpilation, assertions and JSON writing excluded.
methodology.rpc: Actual client reader method calls into real local Manage; counts RPC-equivalent calls, no network/Gateway/serialization latency.
methodology.sidecar: Real UTF-8 JSON files, readFile+JSON.parse on every read. No production schema validation, migration, locking or shard layout.
methodology.git: Real LocalGitAdapter and its default Node execFile runner; wrapper counts pending run calls including failures. No DSH subprocess service.
methodology.completion: First/all complete reader promises, not browser paint. Cache reentry uses the same reader without invalidation.
methodology.excluded: DSH startup/recovery, native Session service, browser rendering, transport, antivirus control, cold disk cache and error scenarios.
methodology.build: Existing lib artifacts must be freshly built by the operator; source revisions and reader artifact hash are recorded.
methodology.fixture: Independent local repositories, one committed file each; 8 managed attached worktrees with bindings and nonempty instructions; fanout uses 12 independent repositories.
methodology.statistics: Warmups retained but excluded from summaries; p95 uses nearest rank; paired deltas retain sign; no wall-time pass/fail threshold.
